dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: Eligibility and booking-window rules were applied correctly
highlights.summary: SpeakSport checked the caller’s frequent-player-card status, confirmed that the requested date was inside the permitted booking window and found an available alternative for a single player.
highlights.quote: “You can book tee times up to seven days in advance. July 24 is within your booking window.” When 11:00 AM was unavailable, SpeakSport offered nearby options and confirmed the caller at 10:21 AM on the Raven course.

highlights.title: Rate guidance flowed directly into a completed booking
highlights.summary: The caller received clear public and twilight pricing, then moved straight into availability and completed the reservation without needing the golf shop.
highlights.quote: “Our standard public green fee from noon to 5:00 PM is $43.19. After 5:00 PM, our twilight rate is $33.80.” SpeakSport then confirmed two players at 3:00 PM on the Raven course.

highlights.title: Booking and email confirmation were handled together
highlights.summary: After securing the requested alternative time, SpeakSport confirmed the full reservation and answered the caller’s follow-up question about receiving the details by email.
highlights.quote: “Your tee time for three players is confirmed at 11:24 AM on the Falcon course with golf carts included.” When asked about email: “Yes, you can look forward to receiving an email confirmation.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Frequent-player-card context, advance-booking windows and other booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Osprey Point to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, course preferences and caller outcomes.
